items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I went to Pencil Court and Milton White and somebody

ctx.x: You never played out of time with him up on the road or something?

No, I don't know. I believe we went to, what the hell I went, I went to Pencil Court and Milton White and somebody, I know I went there with Andrew Anderson, and I went to Keith McPhee with George Williams, you know there's a naval bass player.
I was just getting everything out so you could sign the release and I couldn't pay you and stuff like that. Oh ok.
